coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) during file audits should trigger a retry or fallback mechanism rather than immediately failing the entire package audit and returning an inconclusive verdict.
If one model fails on a specific file due to a tool error, the orchestrator should rely on the successful audits of other models for that file instead of poisoning the overall package verdict.
